notes: Sheet is rotated: the compass N points up and to the right. Cutter Street is printed 'CUTTER (PARK)'; south of W. 3rd the same line is printed 'PARK (VACATED)' and is built over by the yard, so Cutter/W. 3rd is kind T; lots south of W. 3rd reach about x=2400. Sweeney is printed 'SWEENEY (WEBB)' (20 ft), no suffix; 'Street' added as on sheet 7. West of Mill an unlabelled 8 ft alley (y about 1110-1150) meets Mill about 110 px south of Sweeney; it is taken to be Webb Alley (sheet 7 'WEBB ALLEY' runs from Baymiller to here; key map 'WEBB' between Stone and Mill). Alleys printed 'OTITTS ALLEY', 'ANDERSON ALLEY', 'BROOKS ALLEY', each 10 ft. Mill crosses the rail yard south of the alleys on the 'Iron Bridge' (with 'Foot Bridge' labels each side) and reaches W. 2nd at the bottom left. The Mill/W. 2nd/W. Front junction at the bottom-left corner is a five-way open area; W. Front jogs at Mill (the SE leg is about 70 px SW of the NW leg's line). Mill/W. Front is given on the SE-leg centreline to match sheet 1 (about +/-25 px); the NW-leg centreline meets Mill near (565,4376). W. 2nd ends at Mill from the east. Webb Alley, W. 4th and W. 3rd stop at the edge of the mapped area west of Mill (not dead ends).
